PROJECT SCOPES

Bring us a problem or a design ready for review.

01 / SERVICE

Motor and actuator mechanical design

Bearing housings, motor mounts, rotor interfaces, thermal housings, and mechanical assemblies designed around your package and interfaces.

Typical deliverables: CAD models, interface drawings, and an assembly design review.

02 / SERVICE

Electronics enclosure and thermal engineering

PCB mounting, connector access, enclosure layout, heat paths, and provisions for shielding and serviceability.

Typical deliverables: Enclosure CAD, thermal design notes, and manufacturing drawings.

03 / SERVICE

Robotics fixtures and prototype assemblies

Design for positioning fixtures, grippers, mounts, and prototype actuator assemblies. Fabrication can be coordinated through partners.

Typical deliverables: Fixture or assembly drawings, a parts list, and an agreed prototype build plan.

04 / SERVICE

BLDC motor controls and PCB development

Scoped controller and firmware design, motor characterization, electrical prototype support, and integration with the host system.

Typical deliverables: A defined package of schematics, firmware, integration notes, or bench test results.

05 / SERVICE

Design for manufacturing and prototype sourcing

Review part geometry, materials, tolerances, and inspection needs. Prepare drawings for quote and coordinate machining, inspection, or delivery through partners as agreed.

Typical deliverables: Drawings suitable for quoting, a sourcing plan, and agreed inspection requirements.

HOW THE WORK IS DELIVERED

Engineering led by our team.

We scope and lead mechanical and electrical design, controls, thermal packaging, and manufacturing documentation.

Fabrication coordinated with partners.

When a project calls for machining, PCB fabrication or assembly, or specialist inspection, the quote identifies the partner work and who is responsible for delivery. Our own precision CNC capability is planned.

Each quote defines the deliverables, schedule, review points, and partner costs before work begins.
